fact: An official named Anteneh said the prime minister recently established a board that approved the creation of a national data exchange platform to let government systems communicate, which the article's passages do not describe as live; the date is the article's publication date, as it gives none.

The World Bank (IDA) financing agreement, signed 20-21 December 2023, funds development of a whole-of-government data exchange platform with open APIs to integrate Fayda, payment systems and other digital public infrastructure (Part 4.2).
